evidence.notes: Irregular verb with suppletive stems (assieds/asseyons, assis). Despite the -oir infinitive it is a 3rd-group verb; the pronominal s'asseoir conjugates identically. Confident.
Regular -er verb; infinitive ends in -er and follows the regular 1st-group pattern. Confident.
